caveats: Prompt written after reading answer-v1 failures on these dev items; the rules are general (cite every sentence) but a pass is optimistic until confirmed on held-out queries.

decision_rule.drift_guard: if the anchors' mean faithfulness moves by more than 0.05 between Terra sessions, report only (no replacement)
decision_rule.mini_v2: diagnostic only: whether the prompt helps a model that already qualifies; switching mini's prompt would need its own decision
decision_rule.qualifies_if: the answer-eval-v2 rule unchanged: faithfulness and citation precision 95% CI lower bound of (candidate - yardstick) >= -0.05; abstain accuracy (v2) >= 0.80; false abstain (v2) <= 0.10; format valid >= 0.95
decision_rule.replace: luna with answer-v2 replaces mini answer-v1 if it qualifies and costs less per answer

evaluation_set: answer-dev-v1, full stage (125 items), same Decision46 top10 evidence as Decision 48
grader: GPT-6.1 Terra via the owner's chat session (terra-v2.xlsx), same rubric and caveat column; 20 answer-v1 answers each from gpt-5.4 and mini mixed in blind to measure drift
parser: final_answer phase only when a reply has phased messages (bug fix, model-general)
question: Does answer-v2 make GPT-6 Luna qualify under Decision 48's rule, so it can replace GPT-5.4 mini as the cheaper AI-summary model?
yardstick: gpt-5.4 answer-v1 answers and their GPT-6.1 Terra grades (unchanged)
